skills.label: Mindscape 6: We Are the World
skills.gameText: While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, the DMG multiplier for Tremolo and Tone Clusters released or followed up with will increase to 200% of the original, and CRIT Rate is increased by 80%. When triggering a Precise Assist, Astra Yao will automatically follow up with the charged 3rd-hit of Basic Attack: "Capriccio", with a 80% increased CRIT Rate. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Razor Wire
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.

skills.label: Passive: Bind
skills.gameText:
When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate Burning Embers.
When Evelyn consumes Burning Embers to activate Garrote or consumes Decibels to perform an Ultimate, she gains 1 Burning Tether Point.
Once Evelyn has 3 Burning Tether Points, her next use of Garrote will consume all Burning Tether Points to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form
skills.gameText:
When Burning Embers is at 50% or higher, hold [Basic Attack button] or [Special Attack button] to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a slashing attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form
skills.gameText:
When Burning Embers is 50% or higher, after using Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form, continue to hold [Basic Attack button] or [Special Attack button] to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.label: Dodge: Arc Step
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Strangling Reversal
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Fire DMG;
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Locked Position
skills.gameText:
Before entering Binding Seal, press [Special Attack button] or [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form
skills.gameText:
After entering Binding Seal, press or hold [Special Attack button] to activate:
Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing Fire DMG. Binding Seal will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers.
After tethering surrounding enemies, press [Basic Attack button] to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Basic Attack's 3rd hit.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
skills.gameText:
After entering Binding Seal and with enough Energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Binding Seal will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press [Basic Attack button] to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Basic Attack's 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the Dance of Awakened Fire state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the Dance of Awakened Fire state, when Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Points to activate Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, she will retain 1 point of Burning Tether Point. When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target, entering Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.label: Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Shadow
skills.gameText:
While under the Dance of Awakened Fire state, and when Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Fierce Blade
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Silent Protection
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Course Disruption
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Evelyn slashes with Lunalux Garrote, then triggers an explosion ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Entangle (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText: Upon entering Binding Seal, Evelyn's CRIT Rate increases by 25%. After leaving Binding Seal, she retains the buff for 10s. If Evelyn switches to another character while in Binding Seal, she will automatically follow up with Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Ambush Point
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Evelyn's Chain Attack and Ultimate DMG increases by 30%. When Evelyn's CRIT Rate is at or over 80%, the DMG multiplier for her Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre and Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Shadow increases to 125% of the original value.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Dreamweave
skills.gameText: Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1,500 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. Enemies affected by Binding Seal will be Bound. When Evelyn attacks Bound enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF. When Evelyn uses Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form or EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form, the Bound effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread Bound effect lasts for 10s.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Dance of Fire
skills.gameText: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form or Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form, the Burning Embers consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Point to trigger Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Metamorphosis
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Fate's Melody
skills.gameText: Upon activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Crimson Threads Like the Dawn
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Bond of Light and Shadow
skills.gameText: Upon launching a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn gains Shadowstring Edge for 20s. During Shadowstring Edge, when Evelyn hits her primary target with a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, she additionally executes a Lunalux Garrote follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG equal to 375% of her ATK to enemies in the area. This DMG is considered Chain Attack DMG and can trigger up to 16 times. Gaining another Shadowstring Edge will refresh the trigger count.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Feathered Strike
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
After triggering the fourth attack, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, holding [Basic Attack button] during the fourth attack will activate the Fluttering Frock state.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] while in the Noblewoman state to activate:
Dash forward with an attack that deals Ether DMG and restores 1 Flight Feather upon hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered during the dash, gain 1 additional Flight Feather.
If Flight Feathers are available after the skill, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge button] when the skill is used.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] while in the Fluttering Frock state to activate:
Attack an area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
After activation, this skill consumes all Flight Feathers, and each one consumed grants 1 Guard Feather.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When switching characters during the Fluttering Frock state, Vivian will automatically perform Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension.
While in the Fluttering Frock state, press [Dodge button] to exit the state.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Featherbloom
skills.gameText:
After any squad member hits a target with an EX Special Attack, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Basic Attack: Featherbloom against the target, dealing Ether DMG, triggering at most once per use of a skill. This effect can trigger even while Vivian is off-field.
A maximum of 5 Guard Feathers can be stored.

skills.label: Dodge: Lightstream
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Silver Thorned Melody
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Launches a forward thrust at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Wingblade Reverb
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After activating the skill, enter the Noblewoman state.
When there are Flight Feathers available, hold [Basic Attack button] during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

skills.label: Dodge: Dainty Steps
skills.gameText:
When in the Noblewoman state and about to be attacked, an automatic dodge will trigger, during which the character will be Invulnerable, but a Perfect Dodge will not be triggered.
This can trigger once each time the Noblewoman state is entered.

skills.label: Special Attack: Song of Silver Wings
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Quickly attack forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Unleash a powerful forward attack that deals massive Ether DMG and grants 3 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Enter the Fluttering Frock state after using the skill. Hold [Dodge button] during the skill to enter the Noblewoman state.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Chorus of Celestial Wings
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 2 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge button] during the skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Soaring Bird's Song
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 5 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill is activated, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge button] during the skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Frostwing Guard
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, hold [Basic Attack button] during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Silver Umbrella Formation
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Featherblade Execution
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch an attack at enemies ahead, dealing Ether DMG and gaining 2 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge button] during the skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Dirge of Destiny (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
When Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 6.15%/3.2%/8%/0.75%/1.08%/0.32% per 10 points of Anomaly Proficiency of the original Anomaly's DMG.
When Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension or Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering any Attribute Anomaly, apply Vivian's Prophecy to the target, causing the target to take Ether DMG equal to 55% of Vivian's ATK every 0.55s. This DMG can trigger the additional DMG of Attribute Anomalies. When the enemy is no longer suffering an Attribute Anomaly, Vivian's Prophecy expires.
Upon entering the battlefield, Vivian gains 2 Flight Feathers.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Prophetic Tears
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same attribute:
Whenever another squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Basic Attack: Featherbloom on the target. This can trigger once every 0.5s.
Corruption DMG dealt by all squad members and the Corruption status' Disorder DMG increases by 12%.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: "Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"
skills.gameText: When a total of 4 Guard Feathers are consumed, gain 1 Flight Feather. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG received by targets under Vivian's Prophecy increases by 16%.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: "Stormy Night, Stormy Night"
skills.gameText: Vivian's Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 25%. The benefits of Abloom from Anomaly Proficiency are raised to 130% of the original value, and 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES is ignored.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: "Another and the Same"
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: "The Wind Between the Reeds"
skills.gameText:
Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension and Basic Attack: Featherbloom will always CRIT on hit, and they will also increase Vivian's ATK by 12% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When entering the battlefield, Vivian immediately gains 5 Guard Feathers.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: "Sonnet"
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: "Vivian"
skills.gameText: Vivian's Ether DMG increases by 40%. When triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz's dash, or using EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem, gain 1 additional Flight Feather. Launching Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension consumes all Guard Feathers, the downward attack's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of Abloom. Each additional Guard Feather consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomaly DMG dealt by that instance of Abloom, consuming a maximum of 5 Guard Feathers to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Glacial Judgment
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to five slashes forward, the first dealing Physical DMG, and the following four Ice DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Final Verdict
skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive Ice DMG.
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of Basic Attack: Final Verdict, Chain Attack, or Assist Follow-Up hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals (12 + 1 × Basic Attack level)% of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any Ether Veil, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If Frostbite Points are maxed out when the skill activates, all Frostbite Points are consumed to trigger Ether Veil: Wellspring and a Quick Assist. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dodge: Bunny Hop
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Bouncing Dash
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ice DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Swift Blink
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Performs a falling slash ahead, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to (1 + 0.06 × Special Attack level)% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra
skills.gameText:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Launches multiple forward slashes, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to (1 + 0.06 × Special Attack level)% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.
Upon activating this skill, gain 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Temporary Alliance
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
After using this skill, gains 5 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Bunny Barrage
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks in front, followed by a falling slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
After using this skill, gains 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Entry Skill: Burst of Frost
skills.gameText:
When Zhao has maximum Frostbite Points, and is in combat, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks forward, followed by a slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Patch the Gaps
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches a falling slash in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Frostveil Suppression
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Frostlight Reflection
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, if Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Ideal Colleague (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining 1.4% CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 Frostbite Points. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of Frostbite Points is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 Frostbite Points. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When Frostbite Points are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her Entry Skill.
When Zhao activates her Entry Skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Wellspring ends the existing instance before applying a new Ether Veil: Wellspring.
When Zhao activates Ether Veil: Wellspring, all squad members' ATK increase by 1,000 for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Crystallization
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Anomaly, or Support character:
When Zhao is within any Ether Veil, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10%. If Zhao's initial Max HP exceeds 15,000, every additional 400 initial Max HP increases this DMG bonus by an additional 1%, up to a total maximum increase of 40%. This bonus reaches its maximum when Zhao's initial Max HP reaches 27,000.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Righteous Verdict
skills.gameText: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Krampus Senior
skills.gameText: When Zhao recovers HP, her ATK increases by 20%, and other squad members' ATK increases by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Frostveil Edge
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Featherlight Footsteps
skills.gameText: When Zhao activates an Ether Veil, she gains 250 Decibels. The CRIT DMG of her Ultimate, Chain Attack, and Basic Attack: Final Verdict increase by 40%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Fuzzy Listener
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: No Value Has Its Own Value
skills.gameText: The CRIT Rate buff from Core Passive: Ideal Colleague increases to 125% of the original value. The extra DMG gained from charging during Basic Attack: Final Verdict increases to 140% of the original value, and accumulated charge time is no longer consumed when attacking.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Swift Strike
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Leaping Strike
skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Leap forward and unleash a series of slashes, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge: Reversal Shot
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: First Strike Advantage
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward and slash, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Relentless Retribution
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, then follow up with a swift slash, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Rending Claw
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Perform a rapid back-and-forth piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow
skills.gameText:
While Pulchra is in the Hunter's Gait state, and when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with a heavy attack from a Special Attack or EX Special Attack:
Dash back-and-forth piercing enemies centered on the target, dealing Physical DMG.
After using this skill, if another active character in the squad hits an enemy, Pulchra will repeat the attack up to 5 additional times, with the final attack being a more powerful Finishing Move.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow is an Aftershock attack.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Pierce back and forth times, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a charged shot forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Unleash a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Contract - Bodyguard
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, followed by rapid slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Evasive Assist: Contract - Outsourced Combat
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Leap forward into the air and fire, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 1 Assist Point to enter the Hunter's Gait state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText: When Pulchra activates an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Hunter's Gait state, increasing the Daze she deals by 30% for 6s. After switching to another character, if Pulchra is still in the Hunter's Gait state, the state will last until Pulchra switches back in. While in the Hunter's Gait state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a Quick Assist from the previous character in the squad.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Business Partner
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character or shares the same Faction:
When Pulchra hits enemies with Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow, EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep, Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing, Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?, or Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?, it applies the Binding Trap effect for 15s. After applying Binding Trap, all units' Aftershock DMG against the target is increased by 30%.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Self-Interest
skills.gameText: When dealing DMG to enemies affected by Binding Trap, increase own CRIT Rate by 10%.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Opportunistic
skills.gameText: While in the Hunter's Gait state from Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct, Pulchra's ATK is increased by an additional 10%.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Territorial
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Joy of the Hunt
skills.gameText: Reduces Energy Cost of activating EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep by 5.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Tail Game
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Behind the Mask
skills.gameText: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2. Additional Ability: Business Partner's Binding Trap effect now also applies to all damage types, not just Aftershock DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Cold-Bore Shot
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 shots ahead. The first 3 hits deal Physical DMG, the 4th hit deals Electric DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Silenced Shot
skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Trigger enters the Sniper Stance and fires forward continuously, dealing Electric DMG.
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the joystick to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a Perfect Dodge, followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing [Basic Attack button], Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit Sniper Stance.
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 Purge, up to a maximum of 100 Purge.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. A Quick Assist can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot
skills.gameText:
When Trigger has Purge, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, Dash Attack or Quick Assist to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fire two shots at the enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 3 Purge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot is an Aftershock attack.
The squad can trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot once every 3s.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus
skills.gameText:
When Trigger has Purge, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a heavy attack from an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, or Ultimate to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fires three shots at the enemy, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 5 Purge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus is an Aftershock attack.
The same skill type can trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus up to 2 times within 20s for the entire squad.
During Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot, Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus will immediately activate instead if triggered.

skills.label: Dodge: Phantom Concealment
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Vengeful Specter
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly lift the gun and fire, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Condemned Soul
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Spectral Flash
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Flash Burial
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Stygian Guide
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes continuous powerful shots forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Underworld Requiem
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Cold-Bore Cover Fire
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Delaying Demise
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Piercing Thunder
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, followed by a powerful charged shot after landing, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText: When Trigger's Aftershock hits an enemy, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35% for 5s. This Stun DMG Multiplier increase will apply even if the target isn't stunned.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Silver Lantern's Gaze
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same attribute:
When Trigger's CRIT Rate exceeds 40%, each 1% CRIT Rate above this threshold increases her Daze dealt by Aftershocks by 1.5%, up to a maximum increase of 75%.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Sharpened Senses
skills.gameText: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze is increased by an additional 20%. When activating Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. Purge gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in Sniper Stance increases by 25%. Maximum Purge increases to 125.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: "Ether Vision"
skills.gameText: Upon using an Aftershock, Trigger gains 1 stack of Hunter's Gaze. When executing a Finishing Move in Sniper Stance, Trigger gains 2 stacks of Hunter's Gaze. Each stack of Hunter's Gaze increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: "Homecoming"
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Concealment
skills.gameText: When Trigger enters or extends Coordinated Support, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot or Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus, it will trigger Disconnect upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Locked In
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Beyond the River of the Dead
skills.gameText: Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 Armor Break Rounds. For every 25 Purge consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional Armor Break Round, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. While possessing Armor Break Rounds, when Trigger hits a target in Sniper Stance, 1 Armor Break Round is consumed to deal additional Electric DMG equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK. Armor Break Round DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to five attacks forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
This skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Ink‐Veil Cloud Coalescence
skills.gameText:
Hold [Dodge button] to activate:
Deploy a Grand Tai Chi Formation, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, automatically launch the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Auric Array
skills.gameText:
While possessing an Auric Ink Point: tap [Basic Attack button] during Dodge: Nimbus Step, or hold [Dodge button] to activate:
Deploy an array, continuously dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, it automatically triggers Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption.
While channeling, continuously recover Adrenaline, recovering 7/s, for up to 3s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, and enters the Vital View state.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption
skills.gameText:
Automatically activates when Basic Attack: Auric Array reaches the max duration:
Spreads her wings to launch an explosive attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dodge: Hidden Cloud Technique
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Skybreaker
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Launch a forward rush attack, dealing Auric Ink DMG.

skills.label: Dodge: Nimbus Step
skills.gameText:
When dragging the joystick, hold [Dodge button] to activate:
Enter a high‐speed Light as Air state. While in the Light as Air state in Investigation Zone Mode, automatically collect from all resource pickup points within range.
While in the Light as Air state, use the joystick to steer. Release the joystick to stop.
Character is invulnerable at the moment this skill activates.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Banishing Blow
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Shadow-Ignition
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Swiftly retreat, then attack forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
While retreating, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Dodge Counter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation
skills.gameText:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Charge continuously, and release [EX Special Attack button] to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press [Special Attack button] to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack button] to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge button] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper
skills.gameText:
With enough Adrenaline, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Continuously charge up, channeling energy around enemies to deal DMG over time, up to a max of 2s, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Once fully charged or if interrupted, automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows.
At the moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered. After the Perfect Dodge, enter the Vital View state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows
skills.gameText:
Triggers automatically during EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper:
When the energy orb appears and contracts, it deals Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Auric Ink Rush
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Rapidly dash forward and attack, followed by an explosive wing burst, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Launch a barrage of wing attacks, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge button] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression
skills.gameText:
With enough Technique Points, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Consumes 120 Technique Points to spread her wings, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
With both enough Technique Points and Decibels, this skill triggers with priority.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge button] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Cloudstream Shadow
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Clear Sky Surge
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Celestial Cloud Blitz
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Grandmaster of Mysticism (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Auric Ink DMG Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by 60%.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Auric Ink Undercurrent
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Stun, Support, or Defense character:
When a fellow squad member uses an Ultimate, Yixuan continuously recovers 2 Adrenaline for 10s. If Yixuan is switched out by a Perfect Assist, she automatically follows up with a lightning strike attack, dealing DMG equal to 225% of her Sheer Force and restoring an additional 5 Adrenaline.
EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows deal 30% increased DMG to Stunned enemies.
After activating her Ultimate, Yixuan enters the Meditation state, increasing her CRIT DMG by 40% for 15s.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Spiritual Path
skills.gameText: Upon entering combat, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 Technique Points. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Ward Off Misfortune
skills.gameText: When an Ultimate or EX Special Attack deals DMG, it ignores 15% of the target's Ether RES. Triggering Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade extends all enemies' Stunned state by 3s. In a single Stun state duration, enemies can only have this effect applied once, and it does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, when using Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, gain one stack of the Condensed Ink effect. After Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption or EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows, press the Basic Attack button, or after EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break, press the Special Attack button to consume one stack of Condensed Ink and launch EX Special Attack: Endless Talisman Suppression - Break, dealing DMG up to 1,200% of Sheer Force. Only one stack of Condensed Ink can be held at a time.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Cycle of Yin and Yang
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: The One Path of Mysticism
skills.gameText: Activating an  Ultimate grants one stack of Tranquility, up to a max of 2 stacks. For each stack of Tranquility, the next EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper DMG and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows DMG increase by 30%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Calm Sky Vigil
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Swift Yet Still
skills.gameText: After using Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade, gain a stack of the Regulated Breathing effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the Technique Point cost to launch Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression once. The Regulated Breathing effect ends after Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of Regulated Breathing can be held. Additionally, while in the Meditation state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Penetrating Shock
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing Electric DMG. After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack button] to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Penetrating Shock (Agent Potential 1+)
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
On the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, enemies are continuously pulled in.
After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack button] to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

skills.label: Dodge: Strobe
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Torrent
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a horizontal slash forward, then follow up with a thrust attack, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter (Agent Potential 1+)
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform consecutive slashes at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG. On hit, gain the Voltage Overload state for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
While in the Voltage Overload state, dodge performance is enhanced. Additionally, when using Basic Attack/Dash Attack/Dodge Counter, if the enemy target has White Thunder, pressing [Special Attack button] will immediately cancel the current skill and launch Special Attack: Azure Flash.
While in this state, if the enemy does not have White Thunder, press [EX Special Attack button] to directly launch EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Celestial Thunder
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Dash diagonally forward, then unleash a cross slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Azure Flash
skills.gameText:
When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the Silver Star mark and charges the target
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of White Thunder, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has White Thunder, press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of White Thunder to trigger an Aftershock that deals 1 extra instance of Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Thunder Smite
skills.gameText:
When the additional damage from White Thunder triggers 3 times on the same enemy:
A lightning strike will fall at the enemy's location, dealing Electric DMG to enemies within range.
This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.

skills.label: Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary (Agent Potential 1+)
skills.gameText:
When Special Attack: Thunder Smite DMG is triggered:
If EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt or Special Attack: Azure Flash is currently being used, then Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will automatically trigger when the current skill ends, unleashing a flurry of slashes that deal multiple instances of Electric DMG. This skill counts as an Aftershock.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt
skills.gameText:
With enough energy, hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Leaping Thunderstrike
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Leap forward, then quickly dive and perform a cross slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Voidstrike
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Cloud Flash
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Counter Surge
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Conducting Blow
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Voltage Gap (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText: Soldier 0 - Anby's DMG against enemies with the Silver Star mark increases by 25%. After an enemy is marked with Silver Star, the CRIT DMG received from Aftershock attacks is further increased by 30% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Voltage Surge
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 10%. When Soldier 0 - Anby is the active character, all squad members' Aftershock DMG to enemies with a Silver Star mark increases by 25%.

skills.label: Core Passive: Voltage Gap (Core Skill level 7) (Agent Potential 1+)
skills.gameText:
Soldier 0 - Anby deals 25% more DMG to enemies marked with Silver Star. When an enemy is afflicted with Silver Star, they take additional CRIT DMG from Aftershocks, equal to 30% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG. When marked with a Silver Star, DMG from allies' Aftershocks builds  Silver Star charge on the enemy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
The Aftershock CRIT DMG bonus from Silver Star is further increased by 5% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG. When an enemy afflicted with White Thunder is defeated, automatically unleash Special Attack: Thunder Smite on the nearest enemy target.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Voltage Surge (Agent Potential 1+)
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 10%. When the current active character is Soldier 0 - Anby, all squad members' Aftershocks deal 25% more DMG to enemies marked with Silver Star.
Soldier 0 - Anby's Chain Attack and Ultimate are treated as Aftershock DMG.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Static Charge
skills.gameText: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an EX Special Attack to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from White Thunder 3 times. This effect does not consume any White Thunder stacks.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Fail-Safe Protocol
skills.gameText:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her Ultimate, she gains 6 stacks of Thunder's Cry (max 6 stacks). With Thunder's Cry, when using Special Attack: Azure Flash to hit an enemy with White Thunder, it will consume 1 stack of Thunder's Cry instead. Only 1 stack of Thunder's Cry will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming Thunder's Cry will still activate the additional DMG from White Thunder.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of Thunder's Cry consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Past Glory
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Silver Reverb
skills.gameText: When hitting an enemy marked with Silver Star, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's Electric RES.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Director's Cut
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Prequel Protagonist
skills.gameText: Upon triggering 6 instances of White Thunder's additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as Electric DMG against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.

skills.label: Awakened Potential: Electropulse (Agent Potential 2+, numbers at 6)
skills.gameText: During Additional Ability: Voltage Surge, all squad members' Aftershock DMG against enemies marked with Silver Star is increased to 50%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Slash forward up to four times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press [Basic Attack button] to maintain the combo and keep striking the enemy.
During the 3rd hit, hold or pause before pressing [Basic Attack button] to chain into the 4th hit.
During the 3rd hit, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Hu Wei
skills.gameText:
During combat, Hu Wei will automatically attack enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
Upon hitting an enemy, gain 20 points of Might, triggering up to once per use of a skill. The maximum for Might is 200.

skills.label: Dodge: Tiger Seven Forms - Tigerwind
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick slash forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game
skills.gameText:
After using Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the joystick to move and deal Physical DMG upon contact with enemies.
After Ju Fufu gains Momentum from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state. Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of Momentum is consumed, changing the DMG to Fire DMG and granting 25 points of Might. The maximum for Momentum is 15.
When consuming Momentum to deal Fire DMG, if Might is above 100 points, 100 points of Might will be automatically consumed to trigger Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron.
Releasing [Basic Attack button] will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw Hu Wei to attack enemies, dealing Fire DMG. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy.
While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes Invulnerable.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Tiger Seven Forms - Reignited Mountain
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform multiple slashes on enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain-Descending Tiger
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash forward, followed by a falling slash, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms Alt - Mountain-Descending Savage Tiger
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Swing Hu Wei forward for a powerful strike, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 points of Momentum and 80 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Tiger Cauldron Collapse
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Swing Hu Wei to deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron
skills.gameText:
With at least 100 points of Might, after triggering a Chain Attack, automatically activate:
Consume 100 Might to open Hu Wei and fire flames and popcorn at enemies, striking them in a small area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
If Momentum is available, and while not the active character, the high-speed spinning state will activate after the skill ends.
This is an Aftershock. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Tiger Seven Forms - Raging Tiger Explosion
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Perform two downward attacks with Hu Wei, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 6 points of Momentum and 100 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Decisive Stomp
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Steadfast Crouching Tiger
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Feral Blazing Maw
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, then use Hu Wei to follow up with a downward attack, dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 1 point of Momentum upon activation at most once every 10s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Fu-rocious Might (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
When Ju Fufu has yet to use Hu Wei, it will automatically attack enemies and gain Might upon hitting them.
When Hu Wei hits an enemy and has at least 100 Might, and Ju Fufu is not the currently active character, Ju Fufu will launch Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron centered around the target enemy. Upon activation, all squad members gain the Tiger's Roar effect: CRIT DMG increases by 20%, and when Ju Fufu's initial ATK is greater than or equal to 2,800, every additional 100 ATK further increases CRIT DMG by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%.
While in the Tiger's Roar state, character Chain Attack/Ultimate DMG increases by 20%/40%.
The Tiger's Roar state lasts for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, Impact increases by 50.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Aura of Authority
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character:
The maximum Decibels for all characters in the squad increases by 1,000. When an Attack or Rupture character uses an Ultimate, that character gains 300 Decibels.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Super Scary Little Tiger
skills.gameText: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 Might. When Ju Fufu's Chain Attack hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Almighty Qingming Warrior
skills.gameText: While in the Tiger's Roar state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an Ultimate, Ju Fufu gains 3 points of Momentum.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Righteous Young Hero
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Monster-Slaying Tiger Mystic
skills.gameText: While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Unrivaled Almighty Senior
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Roar of My Inner Tiger
skills.gameText: Ju Fufu's Chain Attack DMG increases by 30%. Upon consuming Momentum and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as Chain Attack DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Celestial Overture
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to 5 slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG.
When Alice triggers Assault through Attribute Anomaly Buildup, the 5th hit of her next Basic Attack is enhanced.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz
skills.gameText:
When Alice's Blade Etiquette reaches 1 bar, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Hold to charge, expending up to 3 bars of Blade Etiquette. Release [Basic Attack button] or when Blade Etiquette is below 1 bar, Alice performs a series of slashes in an area centered on the target enemy, with the number of hits determined by charge level, dealing massive Physical DMG.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz hits, it triggers a special Assault effect: Polarity Assault. This deals DMG equal to 100% of the original Assault, ignoring Anomaly Buildup, and can interact with other Attribute Anomalies, including Physical, to trigger Disorder.
Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dodge: Jumpy Bunny
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Blade-Dancer's Gale
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Ceremony of Swordlight
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Piercing Dawn
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Hurl the blade to strike and pass through enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered.
After triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Basic Attack button] to follow up with the 5th hit of a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross
skills.gameText:
With enough energy, drag the joystick forward and press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
A thrust attack that goes through enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Dodge and restores 10 Blade Etiquette.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Southern Cross
skills.gameText:
With enough energy, and without moving the joystick or when dragging it backwards, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Back away with a slash, then thrust forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Dodge and restores 10 Blade Etiquette.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Starfall Intermission
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes powerful consecutive slashes at enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Starfall Finale
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating this skill restores 200 Blade Etiquette.
Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Intertwined Stab
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Parry Guard
skills.gameText:

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Cross Riposte
skills.gameText:

Charge forward and slash enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
