skills.label: Core Passive: Twin Rainbows of the Swordheart (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
After any squad member inflicts a Physical Anomaly on an enemy, Alice deals additional DMG each 0.95s of its active duration, equal to 2.5% of the original Physical Anomaly DMG. If Disorder is triggered while the enemy is suffering a Physical Anomaly, for every 1s of remaining Physical Anomaly duration, the Disorder DMG multiplier increases by 18%, up to a max of 180%.
When Alice's attacks hit an enemy, she builds up Blade Etiquette. When she triggers an Assault through Anomaly Buildup, she gains 10 Blade Etiquette. Blade Etiquette has a maximum of 300, with each 100 being 1 bar.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz lands, it triggers a special Assault effect: Polarity Assault, dealing 100% of the original Assault DMG, ignoring Anomaly Buildup progress. This can be combined with any Attribute Anomaly, including Physical Anomaly, to trigger Disorder.
When Alice triggers Assault on an enemy, her Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 25% for 30s.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Mystery Hunt
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly or Support character:
When any squad member triggers Disorder, Alice gains 30 Blade Etiquette.
If Alice's Anomaly Mastery exceeds 140, each additional point grants her 1.6 Anomaly Proficiency.
Upon entering the battlefield, Alice gains 300 Blade Etiquette. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Palmful of Cilantro
skills.gameText: When Alice triggers a Polarity Assault, she gains 25 Blade Etiquette. When she triggers Assault against an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 30s.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Sage at the Sword's Tip
skills.gameText: When Ultimate: Starfall Finale's Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers Polarity Assault. All squad members' Assault DMG increases by 15%. Disorder DMG against enemies suffering from Physical Anomaly increases by 15%. Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Symmetrism
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Rosemary on Her Lips
skills.gameText: Alice ignores 10% of the target's Physical RES. Enhanced Basic Attack: Celestial Overture accumulates 25% more Physical Anomaly Buildup.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Passion for the Supernatural
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: A Heart of Thyme
skills.gameText: When Alice uses a third-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz or Ultimate: Starfall Finale, she enters the Victory State for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra attack against the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3,300% of her Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the Victory State again refreshes the available trigger count.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Tanuki Claws
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak
skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Enter a defensive stance for up to 1.5 seconds. If hit during this time, parry the attack and inflict massive Daze against the attacking enemy.
Successfully parrying an attack gains 1 Sugar Points.
Character is invulnerable when successfully parrying.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot
skills.gameText:
When Yuzuha has Sugar Points, landing a hit with other active characters' attacks will have Yuzuha continuously twirl her umbrella and attack centered around the target before launching a powerful shell, dealing Physical DMG. When this attack lands a heavy attack, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point.
Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot is considered an Aftershock.
Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot can be triggered once every 8s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles
skills.gameText:
Enemies under the effect of Sweet Scare will be attacked by a Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles once every 1s.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles initially deals Physical DMG.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by (7 + 1.5 × Basic Attack level)%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max
skills.gameText:
Enemies affected by Sweet Scare will be attacked by a Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max when hit with a heavy attack from Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot or Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max initially deals Physical DMG.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by (7 + 1.5 × Basic Attack level)%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Tanuki Helper
skills.gameText:
When Yuzuha is off-field, tanuki Kama assists the active character in attacking enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
When Yuzuha performs Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak, tanuki Kama joins her in attacking the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
Tanuki Kama inherits Yuzuha's initial ATK.

skills.label: Dodge: Did I Scare You?
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: You're Outta Luck!
skills.gameText:

Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.gameText:

Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Special Attack: Gummy Bombardment
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Fire a cannon shot forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the Sweet Scare state.
Gains 2 Sugar Points upon activation.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!
skills.gameText:
After using Dodge Counter: Time for Payback~, Quick Assist: Dessert Time, Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies, or Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot, or when a Perfect Dodge is triggered, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Quickly throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
On hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the Sweet Scare state.
Gains 2 Sugar Points upon activation.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Sweet Scare
skills.gameText:
The Sweet Scare state lasts for (16 + 2 × Special Attack level)s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by Sweet Scare is first hit by an active character using an attack of their attribute, Flavor Match is triggered against that enemy, changing the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max against that enemy to match that of the character who triggered Flavor Match.
When Sweet Scare is triggered again on an enemy, their existing Flavor Match state is removed. The process can be repeated to change the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max again.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Prank Assault
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Gains 1 Sugar Points when used.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating reaches Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to trigger:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a large area around the character, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Enemies hit with a heavy attack are inflicted with the Sweet Scare state.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members gain (7 + 1.5 × Chain Attack level) Energy.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 Sugar Points.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Dessert Time
skills.gameText:

Strike enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.gameText:

Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.

skills.gameText:

Strike enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot
skills.gameText:

Following a continuous spinning umbrella attack, fire a powerful projectile that deals Physical DMG.

skills.label: Core Passive: Whimsical Wonder (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Upon entering the battlefield, Yuzuha immediately gains 3 Sugar Points.
Yuzuha can have up to 6 Sugar Points.
When Yuzuha's EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!, or Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief hits an enemy, all squad members receive the Tanuki Wish effect.
Tanuki Wish grants an ATK increase equal to 40% of Yuzuha's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of 1,200, and increases the DMG dealt by those with the effect by 15%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Yuzuha's initial ATK reaches 3,000, she grants the full ATK bonus to all squad members.

skills.label: Additional Ability: The More the Merrier
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
If Yuzuha's Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, every point over increases the Anomaly Buildup Rate of characters with Tanuki Wish by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 20%, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 20%. When Yuzuha's Anomaly Mastery is at 200, she grants the full buff effect.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Lucky Constitution
skills.gameText: Yuzuha regains 30 Energy when she enters the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180s. Enemies in the Sweet Scare state have their All-Attribute RES reduced by 10%. The Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG buff from her Additional Ability is increased to 130% of its original value.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Full of Colorful Company
skills.gameText: When Yuzuha's EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!, or Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomaly Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, it will trigger a forced Chain Attack. Chain Attacks triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced Chain Attacks can only occur once every 20s. Whenever another character enters through a Chain Attack, Yuzuha gains 1 Sugar Points. Yuzuha's Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot cooldown is reduced by 25%.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Fairytale of the Haunted City
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Falling Magic
skills.gameText: The DMG of Yuzuha's Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot and Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies increases by 30%, Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20%, and triggers a Quick Assist when it hits an enemy.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Dreams of a Fading Winter
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Put Down Roots
skills.gameText: Gain 1 additional Sugar Points when successfully parrying an enemy attack using a Defensive Assist or Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak. Releasing [Basic Attack button] or reaching full charge fires an extra powerful shell at the enemy. For every 0.4s charged, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point to fire an additional powerful shell, each dealing 300% of her ATK as Physical DMG. If any powerful shell from Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot hits an enemy, all squad members' Disorder DMG Multiplier increases by 105% for 40s, and stacking up to 3 times, with each stack duration being calculated separately. In addition, if the powerful shell hits an enemy under Sweet Scare, it'll trigger 1 Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max attack. If Yuzuha is attacked while charging, she will automatically dodge the attack and immediately unleash the max-charged attack.

skills.label: Special Attack: Touch of Death
skills.gameText:
With Break Force, press [Special Attack button]to activate:
Special Attack: Touch of Death attacks centered on the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
The skill can be chained up to three times. Each use of Special Attack: Touch of Death consumes 1 point of Break Force.
When Pan Yinhu is the active character, DMG received during the skill is reduced by 40% and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If he isn't the active character, he becomes Invulnerable.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike unleashes a powerful strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Gain 3 points of Break Force on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
Agents who enter the field via this Quick Assist will gain the Sheer Force bonus from the Core Passive. After switching out, Pan Yinhu will stay on the field and automatically launch Special Attack: Touch of Death until his Break Force runs out, where he then leaves the field.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Anointed with Wok Steam
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hop onto the Iron Wok and spin rapidly to ram into enemies, dealing massive Physical DMG to all enemies on the way.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Perform a technique that compresses qi into fried rice and catapults it at foes, dealing massive Physical DMG and healing all squad members for (100 + 60 × Chain Attack level) HP, while also applying a 8s heal over time on all squad members, recovering (0.8 + 0.05 × Chain Attack level)% HP/s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Lift Your Gaze to Good Fortune
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Intimidating Presence
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Ride the Momentum
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText: For a brief period when Pan Yinhu's EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike hits an enemy and triggers Quick Assist, the next Agent entering through a Quick Assist or Chain Attack will gain the Meridian Flow effect. This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to 18% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Iron Stomach
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Rupture character or shares the same Faction:
When Pan Yinhu hits an enemy with Special Attack: Touch of Death, the enemy suffers the Depleted Qi effect, increasing DMG from all units against the target by 20%. Each hit of Special Attack: Touch of Death inflicts a 10s Depleted Qi effect. This effect does not stack, but repeated hits on the same enemy will extend the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Qi Shield
skills.gameText: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike
skills.gameText: For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Special Attack: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: First-Class Head Chef
skills.gameText: When Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: "Thiren"
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Meridian Theory
skills.gameText: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Swiftedge
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Can be chained into Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash after the 4th hit.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Cloudstream Sword Will
skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing Physical DMG. Hold to extend the attack.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and on the ground, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
If she possesses Qingming Sword Force, the 3rd hit is replaced with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, after the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a swift rising attack, dealing Physical DMG and entering an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
skills.gameText:
After activating Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation, and with Qingming Sword Force, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 1 point of Qingming Sword Force is consumed.
If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.
After using this skill and with Qingming Sword Force, press [EX Special Attack button] to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light. This skill is automatically followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight
skills.gameText:
In the Enlightened Mind state, and while airborne, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Press [EX Special Attack button] or [Dodge button] to follow up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
skills.gameText:
After the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing Physical DMG.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of Qingming Sword Force, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 2 points of Qingming Sword Force are consumed, granting the Culmination effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses Qingming Sword Force, press [EX Special Attack button] to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, which can be quickly followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Culmination
skills.gameText: During EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, each time Qingming Sword Force is consumed while Culmination is active, the Qingming Sword Force cost is replaced by consuming Culmination instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current Enlightened Mind ends.

skills.label: Dodge: Leave No Trace
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
During the Enlightened Mind state, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, press [Basic Attack button] to activate Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

skills.label: Dodge: Wandering Cloud
skills.gameText:
While tilting the joystick, hold [Dodge button] to activate:
Enters a high-speed movement state. Steer with the joystick, and release the joystick to stop.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Swallow Strike
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Guiding Tides
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If no dodge is available or a Perfect Dodge is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals Physical DMG.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing Physical DMG, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Swiftedge.
Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Gale Suppression
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill.
After this skill is used, gain 1 point of Qingming Sword Force.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and grounded, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing Physical DMG.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, press [Basic Attack button] to quickly activate Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum and enter Vital View.
After this Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum activates, it can be immediately followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
skills.gameText:
In the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive Physical DMG while rapidly consuming Qingming Sword Force until none remains.
The skill ends early if Qingming Sword Force is insufficient or if [EX Special Attack button] is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust
skills.gameText:
In the Enlightened Mind state, press [Ultimate button] or hold [EX Special Attack button] when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG to enemies in a large area.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, Ether Veil: Verdict is removed and the Enlightened Mind state ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Smite the Wicked
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Chasing Storms
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Summons a sword formation and enter the Enlightened Mind state, activating an Ether Veil: Verdict while also gaining 6 Qingming Sword Force. This skill deals massive Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press [Ultimate button] while in this Enlightened Mind state to launch an Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens that doesn't consume Decibels.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, and when a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens
skills.gameText:
After consuming Decibels to launch Ultimate: Chasing Storms and while in the Enlightened Mind state, press [Ultimate button] or hold [EX Special Attack button] when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Summons a massive blade, dealing massive Physical DMG to enemies.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, the Enlightened Mind state ends, and Ether Veil: Verdict is removed.
This skill doesn't consume Decibels.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness
skills.gameText:
With 6 Qingming Sword Force and while not in the Enlightened Mind state, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate, or press [Switch button] while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate:
Enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict.
Deals Physical DMG to enemies in a large area in front.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Enters the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Support Guard
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Cease Hostility
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: When I Return
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Enlightened Mind - Tactical Support
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, when the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Enlightened Mind - Unification
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and after a Defensive Assist, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Burning Clarity (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
When not in the Enlightened Mind state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build Qingming Sword Force. Whenever Qingming Sword Force is gained by any means, each 1 point of Qingming Sword Force that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of Bearer, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the Enlightened Mind state, all Bearer stacks are consumed to grant the same number of Qingming Sword Force stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain Unity, increasing CRIT Rate by 30% and DMG by 25%.
When Ultimate: Chasing Storms or Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict. Ether Veil: Verdict has the same duration as Enlightened Mind. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the Enlightened Mind state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all Physical DMG dealt by her skills becomes Honed Edge DMG.
While Ether Veil: Verdict is active, when an enemy enters Ether Veil: Verdict, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when Ether Veil: Verdict ends.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Shadowtrace Flight
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Defense character:
When a squadmate activates any Ether Veil, gain 3 points of Qingming Sword Force. If already in the Enlightened Mind state, this is instead converted into 3 stacks of Bearer.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Dreambound Self
skills.gameText:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 Qingming Sword Force. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
The Unity effect from Core Passive: Burning Clarity increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Light & Shadow
skills.gameText: The max stack count of Bearer increases to 6, and Culmination can stack up to 9 times. While in the Enlightened Mind state, each point of Qingming Sword Force consumed grants 1 stack of Culmination. EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens's DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Swordswoman
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Together into the Dust
skills.gameText: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. The Vulnerability bonus provided by Ether Veil: Verdict is increased to a maximum of 200%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Guiding Glimmer
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Lantern Wish
skills.gameText: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of Lantern Wish. When entering the Enlightened Mind state, gains 1 stack of Lantern Wish, stacking up to 4 times. With 3 stacks of Lantern Wish, EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust is replaced with Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens. When this Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of Lantern Wish. The last hit of Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens deal 1,500% of ATK as additional Physical DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind Slash
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
During each slash, pressing [Special Attack button] triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to deal increased Fire DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
skills.gameText:
While in the Molten Edge state, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Unleash up to four forward slashes, dealing Fire DMG.
If Manato's HP is above 30% when the skill is activated, 3.5% of his Max HP will be consumed.

skills.label: Dodge: Radiant Blade
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Radiant Blade - Zanshin
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a shoulder slam forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Return to Ashes
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
skills.gameText:
Hold [Special Attack button] to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 Blazing Heart. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate Special Attack: Return to Ashes. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
skills.gameText:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Blazing Eruption
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Musou Aratama
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Lone Shadow - Regroup
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, inflicting massive Daze and dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 75 Blazing Heart upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Mighty Molten Edge (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice or a Defensive Assist, he accumulates Blazing Heart, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 Blazing Heart, Manato enters the Molten Edge state. While in the Molten Edge state, Manato consumes 3.3 Blazing Heart per second. When Blazing Heart is fully depleted, he exits Molten Edge.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's Basic Attacks are enhanced, and he can use EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall.
When consuming HP during Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes from an Assist Follow-Up, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by 50%, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his Fire DMG increases by 20%.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Rekindled Heart
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
When Manato uses his Ultimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes of an Assist Follow-Up, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Drifter's Rules of Survival
skills.gameText: Whenever Manato loses HP, the amount of HP lost is tallied. Each 1% of his Max HP tallied increases the Fire DMG of Assist Follow-Ups and Basic Attacks by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Day & Night, Kitchen & Love
skills.gameText: While in the Molten Edge state, Manato ignores 8% of a target's Fire RES. After being hit by an enemy while using Special Attack: Return to Ashes or Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, press [Basic Attack button] to trigger an Assist Follow-Up.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Childhood Oath
skills.gameText: Max HP increases by 8%. During Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Lone Shadow Returns to the Pack
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Beyond Dreams of the Past
skills.gameText: When Special Attack: Return to Ashes hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing [Basic Attack button] will launch an Assist Follow-Up. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his Assist Follow-Up hits an enemy, Manato's Fire DMG increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Orbital Combo
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Ether DMG.
The fifth attack is a Whim, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts Ether DMG on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Whim.

skills.label: Dodge: Fading Silhouette
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Refraction
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Stardust Echo
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a Whim. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
This Special Attack is a Whim. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When Lucia uses any Harmony, all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional (5 + 0.2 × Special Attack level) Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of (612 + 24 × Special Attack level), lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional (34 + 3 × Special Attack level)% of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Stage of Brilliance
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Charge, Great Armor!
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to (1 + 0.05 × Chain Attack level)% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Crushing Mist
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
This Quick Assist is a Whim. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Voice of Illusory Dreams
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Harmony of Painted Dreams
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
This Assist Follow-Up is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Lost Nocturne (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 Dream Points. If her Dream Points reaches 100 upon activating a Whim or Harmony, she enters the Dream state.
When entering the Dream state, it triggers a Quick Assist and simultaneously activates Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the Dream state, using any Whim consumes 25 Dream Points and upgrades it to Harmony. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 Dream Points to unleash an Aftershock. This Aftershock is a Harmony. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or Aftershock, Aftershock cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an Aftershock, all squad members gain the Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state. While in Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state, DMG dealt increases by 20% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of Dream Points or she leaves the Ether Veil, she exits the Dream state.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Ballad of the Long Night
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Rupture or Stun character:
When applying Darkbreaker, additionally applies a 30% CRIT DMG increase effect.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Secret Friend
skills.gameText: When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate. Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of Echo, stacking up to 4 times. When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme ends, if Lucia has any Echo stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme to all squad members.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Great Magician
skills.gameText: While Lucia is inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, Harmony deals 15% more DMG. Agents in the Darkbreaker state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in Ether Veil: Wellspring.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: The Best Partner
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Late-Night Hours
skills.gameText: When Ether Veil is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Dream Watcher
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: The Never-Ending Journey
skills.gameText: When Lucia is inside any Ether Veil, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and Harmony always triggers a CRIT with Harmony CRIT DMG increased by 30%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Chrysanthemum Wheel Dance
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG for the first two hits and Electric DMG for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter
skills.gameText:
After the 4th hit of a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, hold or press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Summon the mech to perform a charged punch attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When Steel Charge reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter by holding [Basic Attack button]. This effect expires when Steel Charge is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter once.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall
skills.gameText:
Seed has Steel Charge, which she can accumulate by hitting enemies with her skills.
Steel Charge has a maximum value of 150, and an initial value of 60. Upon reaching 120 Steel Charge and triggering Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter or Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!, press or hold [Basic Attack button] to consume 60 Steel Charge and unleash Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form, then automatically consume 60 Steel Charge to follow up with Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form.
Pilots the mech to fire sweeping shots and perform a jumping smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dodge: Running on Petals
skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Blossom Burst
skills.gameText:

skills.label: Special Attack: Withered in Frost
skills.gameText:

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
skills.gameText:

Hold [EX Special Attack button] to extend the barrage duration while continuously consuming Energy.
During flight, release [EX Special Attack button] to trigger EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away.
Upon consuming 60 Energy points in one flight, automatically trigger Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away
skills.gameText:

Unleash rapid cannon fire, dealing Electric DMG.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Tempest of Frosty Petals
skills.gameText:

Summons her mech for protection, then launches cannon shots and a barrage of missiles, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!
skills.gameText:

Seed will pilot the mech personally, raining down missiles and a meteor shower of rockets, then performing a jumping smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, accumulate 60 Steel Charge.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Barrage of Raining Flowers
skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Crimson Core Burst
skills.gameText:

Unleash continuous floating turret attacks at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.label: Core Passive: Flower Chain Protocol (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
The Attack teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's Vanguard.
When the Vanguard unleashes an EX Special Attack, Seed gains Onslaught status, increasing Seed's ATK by 1,000 and CRIT DMG by 30%. When Seed unleashes an EX Special Attack, the Vanguard gains Direct Strike status, increasing the Vanguard's ATK by 1,000 and CRIT DMG by 30%.
When Direct Strike and Onslaught are both active, Seed and the Vanguard simultaneously gain Besiege status, increasing DMG dealt by 25%.
Onslaught, Direct Strike, and Besiege buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a Vanguard, Seed immediately gains Onslaught status and Besiege status, while the Vanguard immediately gains Direct Strike status and Besiege status.
Direct Strike and Onslaught status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the Vanguard consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of Steel Charge.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Surprise Strike
skills.gameText:
When another Attack Character is in your squad:
When Seed deals DMG as the active character, restore 2 Energy to the Vanguard. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Seed's Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter, Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall, and Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom! deal 30% increased DMG and ignore 25% of enemy Electric RES.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: "Hibernation Period"
skills.gameText: When Seed's Steel Charge reaches 100, Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall can be triggered, and the total Steel Charge consumed is reduced to 100. The amount of Steel Charge required to gain one chance to quickly release Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter is reduced to 100. Accumulate an additional 40/20 Steel Charge when entering the battlefield/using Ultimate. Increases Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall CRIT DMG by 30%.

For every 5 Energy consumed by EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, the following Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter's DMG increases by 5%.

Banyue automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dodge: Immovable Mountain

skills.label: Dodge: Overcome Peaks

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Scattering Sands
skills.gameText:
During a dodge, press [Basic Attack button], or during Dodge: Battle Cry, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches beads forward, dealing Fire DMG.
After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks or the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Stoneburst
skills.gameText:
After a Perfect Dodge is triggered through Dodge: Overcome Peaks, press [Basic Attack button], or after a Perfect Dodge is triggered though Dodge: Battle Cry, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a forward attack that deals Fire DMG.
After using this skill, can be chained into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks or the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker
skills.gameText:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
After an Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input [Basic Attack button] [EX Special Attack button] [Basic Attack button] in sequence to activate:
Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor
skills.gameText:

After the 1st or 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input [EX Special Attack button] [EX Special Attack button] [Basic Attack button] in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws a mountain, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: One's Path
skills.gameText:

After an Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input [EX Special Attack button] [Basic Attack button] [EX Special Attack button] in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out his beads, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar
skills.gameText:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input [Basic Attack button] [Basic Attack button] [EX Special Attack button] in sequence to activate:
Banyue sends out a sonic wave forward, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath
skills.gameText:
With enough Adrenaline when using EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker, quickly input [EX Special Attack button] [EX Special Attack button] [Basic Attack button] in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out an even larger mountain, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath
skills.gameText:

Banyue releases a powerful sonic wave in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Cancel
skills.gameText:
When Banyue activates an EX Special Attack ALT through quick input commands, the currently activating EX Special Attack can be interrupted. Each EX Special Attack has its own Perfect Interrupt window. Interrupting an EX Special Attack after its Perfect Interrupt window will not affect the interrupted EX Special Attack's effect. Interrupting an EX Special Attack during the Perfect Interrupt window is equal to triggering a Perfect Cancel.
While in the Visage of Wrath state and with Mountain's Might, Perfect Cancel is easier to trigger.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Blazing Wrath
skills.gameText:

Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
If Banyue has more than 120 Wrathful Fires, he automatically enters the Visage of Wrath state after the attack.

skills.label: Ultimate: The World Trembles
skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

Executes a series of attacks against enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing Fire DMG

skills.label: Core Passive: One With the Mountains (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover Wrathful Fires through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 Wrathful Fires for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon activating Defensive Assist;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires when parrying an enemy with Dodge: Immovable Mountain, and recover 6 Wrathful Fires instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon triggering a Perfect Dodge, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 Wrathful Fires. When he possesses at least 120 Wrathful Fires, Banyue can enter the Visage of Wrath state by using Basic Attack: Immolate. While in Visage of Wrath state, Banyue can no longer gain Wrathful Fires. After Banyue uses Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, he exits the Visage of Wrath state.
When entering the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue gains 4 Mountain's Might. If Banyue has Mountain's Might, launching an EX Special Attack no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 Mountain's Might and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the Visage of Wrath state, remove all Mountain's Might.
When possessing Mountain's Might in Visage of Wrath state, hold [Special Attack button] to launch four different EX Special Attacks and Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an EX Special Attack or Assist Follow-Up, he increases his Sheer Force by 300, Fire DMG by 36%, and CRIT DMG by 36% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Mountain's Zenith
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
While in the Visage of Wrath state, when Banyue consumes Mountain's Might to unleash an EX Special Attack through a Basic Attack branch or quick input commands, he gains one stack of Vidyaraja. Each stack of Vidyaraja increases his Fire DMG by 5%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Greed Burns Like Fire
skills.gameText: When Banyue hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: One's Path or EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker, he inflicts the Tremor state. In this state, enemies' Fire RES is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s. When EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar, EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits an enemy in the Tremor state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%. When Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Anger Cuts Like a Blade
skills.gameText: The CRIT DMG bonus from the Core Passive is increased by an additional 15%, and the Fire DMG bonus is increased by an additional 15%. While in the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue restores an additional 5 Adrenaline when consuming Mountain's Might to unleash an EX Special Attack.

skills.gameText: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks DMG increase by 30%.

skills.gameText: At any time, when Banyue uses an EX Special Attack, he also gains Vidyaraja. The Fire DMG bonus from Vidyaraja is increased by an additional 8%, and its duration is extended to 30s. When activating Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks, Banyue deals Fire DMG equal to 600% of his Sheer Force to nearby enemies. Using Dodge: Battle Cry immediately after an EX Special Attack also grants Vidyaraja.

skills.label: Core Passive: Five-Star Service Hotline (Core Skill level 7)

When EX Special Attack: Paper! hits an enemy, it applies the Malicious Complaint effect. While under Malicious Complaint, if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30%. Before recovering from Stun, Malicious Complaint can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Malicious Complaint recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 Positive Reviews per second. When a heavy attack of EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits enemies, she gains 7.5 Positive Reviews. Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 Positive Reviews, when Dialyn triggers the Chain Attack window using Chain Attack: Welcome Mat, EX Special Attack: Get Lost!, or Quick Assist: Forward Call, the next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate. When an ally launches an Ultimate this way, Dialyn consumes 60 Positive Reviews.
With at least 90 Positive Reviews, when Dialyn hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: Get Lost! and doesn't trigger a Chain Attack window, she consumes 90 Positive Reviews to forcibly trigger a Chain Attack window. The next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate.
Each time Positive Reviews reaches 90 or an Ultimate is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 Customer Complaint. A maximum of 1 Customer Complaint can be held at a time.

When Dialyn uses an EX Special Attack or Ultimate while Overwhelmingly Positive is active, if the remaining duration of Overwhelmingly Positive is less than 35s, its duration is extended by 10s.
When a heavy attack from EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits, additional DMG is dealt based on the previous squad member's Specialty:
If the squad member is an Attack Agent, EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, and EX Special Attack: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 320% of that Attack Agent's ATK.
If the squad member is a Rupture Agent, EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, and EX Special Attack: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that Rupture Agent's Sheer Force.

With Dance Prowess, when a heavy attack from Nangong Yu's EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love, Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, or Quick Assist: Emergency Save hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, 1 stack of Dance Prowess is consumed to trigger the special Disorder effect Polarity Disorder against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's Quick Assist. Polarity Disorder does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly. If the skill fails to trigger Polarity Disorder, Dance Prowess will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has Dance Prowess, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, which will always trigger precise charging.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next EX Special Attack will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.
When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the attack, 1 stack of Dance Prowess will also be consumed to trigger Polarity Disorder on all enemies who meet the conditions.
When the third hit of Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact or Ultimate: Meteor Shower hits an enemy, the enemy suffers Misstep. Under this effect, Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Stun duration increases by 3s. Before recovering from Stun, Misstep can only trigger once on the same target. The increased Stun duration cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Misstep recovers from Stun, the Misstep effect ends.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Lazy Spotlight
skills.gameText: When EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's Downbeat is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Painless Tears
skills.gameText: Each stack of Vibrato's additional Abloom DMG ratio increase from Core Passive: Prodigious Idol increases by an additional 10%. The Stun DMG Multiplier provided by Additional Ability: Angel Captain increases by an additional 30%. When the active character's Chain Attack heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers Polarity Disorder, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once during the same Stun period.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Chips on the Scales
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Accomplice's Dance Step
skills.gameText: Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The Anomaly Buildup of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact when hitting an enemy increases by 35%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Center Stage
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: An Angel's Delusion
skills.gameText: Nangong Yu's attacks deal 50% more Daze. When the enemy is not Stunned, each time any character triggers Abloom DMG, Disorder DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on them, the enemy gains 1 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. When hit by the heavy attack of EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, they gain 1 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. When hit by the heavy attack of Ultimate: Meteor Shower, they gain 2 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. Vibrato: Modified can stack up to 4 times. When the enemy becomes Stunned, all Vibrato: Modified stacks are cleared. When Vibrato: Modified is cleared, if the enemy is under an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of Abloom DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 800%/400%/1,000%/70%/100%/40% of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of Vibrato: Modified on the enemy increases this Abloom DMG ratio by an additional 25%. Vibrato: Modified cannot stack with Vibrato.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Tongue Flick

When the 4th hit lands, gain 2 points of Venom. Hitting a Stunned enemy grants an additional 1 point of Venom.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss
skills.gameText:
With Serpentine Shadow, hold [Basic Attack button] to launch:
Cissia leaps into the air and locks onto a target, then slams down, dealing Electric DMG to enemies in the area.
While locking on, continue to hold [Basic Attack button] and drag the joystick to extend the lock-on duration and freely control the landing position.
For every 6 points of Venom gained, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow, stacking up to 3 times.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow.
Using this skill consumes 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow.
Upon hitting an enemy, all Venom is consumed to trigger Corrode Bone.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

skills.label: Corrode Bone
skills.gameText:

skills.label: Dodge: Slither
skills.gameText:

skills.label: Dash Attack: Bite Mark

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.gameText:

After using this skill, activate Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded, lasting 30s. All squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 5% for the duration.
Re-activating Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded a second time will first deactivate the active Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

skills.label: Core Passive: Fatal Concoction (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:

When there are 1/2 Electric characters in the squad, the Daze dealt by Corrode Bone increases by 40%/60%.

skills.gameText:

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Traveler and Prey
skills.gameText: The Venom gained upon entering the battlefield increases to 6. The DEF ignore from the Core Passive increases to 140% of its original value, and all squad members ignore 5% of the target's Electric RES. Corrode Bone DMG ignores 10% of the target's Electric RES.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Hunger and Hard Truths
skills.gameText: After a Chain Attack: Gang Operation or Ultimate: Ophidiophobia hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 Venom. Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss deals 35% increased DMG.

skills.gameText: When using an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, gain 1 stack of Decidedness, stacking up to 3 times. When using Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss, consume all Decidedness. skills.label: Mindscape 5: False Evidence and Fangs
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

This instance of Corrode Bone cannot inflict Daze, and at most 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion can be consumed every 3s.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie
skills.gameText:

skills.label: Core Passive: Knight's Resolve (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Starlight - Billy gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1. All Physical DMG Starlight - Billy deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
Starlight - Billy restores 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When his HP is greater than 25%, press [Special Attack button] to consume HP and activate Special Attack: Drive Suppression. While in combat, each use of this skill increases his CRIT DMG by 90% for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When HP is at or below 25%, the DMG he takes is reduced by 50%.
Starlight - Billy gains Determination when his attacks hit enemies, with the amount depending on the skill used. Determination regenerates slowly while in combat, and is capped at 120. Hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, activating Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger, or triggering a block restores additional Determination. Triggering a Perfect Dodge by any means restores 3 Determination. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
When Determination is greater than or equal to 100, hold [Basic Attack button] to consume 100 Determination and activate Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight.
Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Knight's Technique restores a small amount of HP. Hitting an enemy with Dodge Counter: Duel King activated through a Perfect Dodge restores HP. Using EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels or EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork restores HP.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Blazing Starlight
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Stun, Defense, or Support character:
Hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Knight's Technique, Chain Attack, or Ultimate grants 1 stack of Starlight for 45s, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, Only one stack can be obtained per use of a skill. Each stack increases the DMG of Chain Attacks, Ultimates, EX Special Attacks, and Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight by 20%.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Heroic Entrance
skills.gameText: Core Passive: Knight's Resolve restores an additional 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack causes Starlight - Billy's DMG to ignore 18% Physical RES for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Wasteland Automaton
skills.gameText: Increases the DMG dealt by Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight, EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, and Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick by 50%. Only 1 stack of Turbocharged can be held.

skills.gameText: Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick and Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight's Sheer DMG increases by 18%. When using Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick or Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight, consumes up to 2 stacks of Brilliant Starlight, with each stack consumed causing that skill's final hit to deal 100% Sheer Force as additional Physical DMG.

skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Promeia leaps into the air and attacks, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the Bound Absolution state, dealing Ice DMG.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate Corrosive Chill.

skills.label: Bound Absolution
skills.gameText:
When using certain skills, Promeia throws her cape to continuously slice enemies, dealing Ice DMG. Does not accumulate Corrosive Chill upon hit.
While the cape remains out, Promeia can walk slowly.
Press [Basic Attack button] or [Special Attack button] during this period to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
If attacked during this period, Promeia triggers a Perfect Dodge automatically. The dodge can trigger once every 20s.

skills.label: Dodge: Veiled Step
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Grim Reap
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:

skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

Leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a descending attack that deals Ice DMG.
After landing, if Promeia possesses Trial by Cold, keep holding [Basic Attack button] or [Special Attack button] to chain into EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost

After landing, if Promeia possesses Trial by Cold, keep holding [Basic Attack button] or [Special Attack button] to chain into EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment
skills.gameText:
With enough Trial by Cold and after performing the final hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge, Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost, or Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost, keep holding [Basic Attack button] or [Special Attack button] after landing to activate:
Quickly leaps back while unleashing a more powerful finishing move, dealing Ice DMG.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate Corrosive Chill.
After using this skill, hold [Basic Attack button] or [Special Attack button], or press [Basic Attack button] to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
