Throws flying blades and hangs upside down above the enemy, unleashing a flurry of attacks and ending with a finishing move, dealing massive Ice DMG.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing 100% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement
skills.gameText:

Launches a series of forward attacks, dealing massive Ice DMG.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing 250% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.gameText:

Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.gameText:

skills.label: Core Passive: Thief of Flames (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
If Promeia's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 150, each additional point increases her Anomaly Proficiency by 1.5 and increases the whole squad's Abloom DMG by 0.35%.
Promeia gains a set amount of Corrosive Chill when her attacks hit enemies. When squad members trigger Freeze/Disorder, when the enemy is inflicted with Vortex, or when Promeia triggers EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow, she gains an additional 5/5/5/10 Corrosive Chill, up to a maximum of 100 Corrosive Chill.
When a squad member triggers and hits an enemy with Abloom, Promeia gains an additional 15 Corrosive Chill.
When Corrosive Chill reaches at least 50, 50 Corrosive Chill is consumed and converted into 1 point of Trial by Cold, up to a maximum of 2 points of Trial by Cold.
Upon entering the battlefield, Promeia gains 2 points of Trial by Cold.
When the finishing move of EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment hits an enemy afflicted with Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing 635% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute. The skill consumes 1 Trial by Cold upon activation.

When Velina triggers Vortex, she gains 1 point of Windbite and summons a Condensed Cyclone, dealing Wind DMG. This effect can trigger once every 3s. When Velina has 2 points of Windbite, the next time she triggers Vortex, 2 points of Windbite are consumed to increase that Vortex's DMG Multiplier by 150%. In addition, a Sweeping Cyclone is summoned instead of a Condensed Cyclone, which does not grant Windbite.
When Velina's summoned Sweeping Cyclone hits an enemy suffering Contamination for the first time, it triggers Chromatic Tint, converting it into a Sweeping Cyclone of the corresponding attribute, dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG. When Sweeping Cyclone hits an enemy, the enemy's Wind Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If a Sweeping Cyclone enhanced by Chromatic Tint hits an enemy, the enemy's corresponding Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES is also reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by Sweeping Cyclone is defeated, the duration of that Sweeping Cyclone is extended by 5s. This effect can only trigger once for the same Sweeping Cyclone, and only one Sweeping Cyclone can exist at a time.
Condensed Cyclone and Sweeping Cyclone trigger an explosion when they dissipate. If this explosion hits an enemy suffering a Wind Anomaly, it triggers one instance of Abloom DMG against the target: resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG, dealing a fixed 145% and 255% multiplier Wind Anomaly DMG respectively.

For Core Passive: Breeze in Bloom, the Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES reduction from Sweeping Cyclone is further increased by 7%, while Daze inflicted increases by 30%, and accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup increases by 15%.

skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Launches a ranged attack ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Ode to Dawn
skills.gameText:
Upon entering the battlefield, if Remielle has less than 60 Energy, her Energy is recovered to 60. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to all enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
skills.gameText:
When Remielle is in combat and her Floating Radiance reaches its maximum of 120, hold [Special Attack button] after a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to enter Stance Shift. Switching characters while in Stance Shift causes Remielle to enter the Phase Flow state:
While in the Phase Flow state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. In this state, Floating Radiance is consumed over time, and some of her attacks apply Lumiflux Buildup to the target. When Floating Radiance is fully depleted or upon leaving combat, Remielle exits the Phase Flow state. Before exiting the Phase Flow state, Remielle cannot be actively switched in except via a Chain Attack.
If Remielle triggers 3 Refringe reactions in one Phase Flow state, or has at least 1 stored Voidflare when Floating Radiance is fully depleted, Assist: Flower & Feather Dance becomes available, and her normal switch-in is unlocked. Assist: Flower & Feather Dance is automatically used on Remielle's next normal switch-in.
Upon entering the Phase Flow state, Remielle increases all squad members's DMG by (0 + 1.5 × Special Attack level)% for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Remielle's Floating Radiance has reached its maximum of 120 and her Special Attack or EX Special Attack hits a Stunned enemy, she can also enter the Phase Flow state by switching characters during the Special Attack or EX Special Attack.
If no character is switched in after entering Stance Shift, Remielle uses a downward attack to return to the ground instead.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Interwoven Dance Steps
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple attacks ahead in a large area, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Enters the Luminous Reflection state upon activation. The next Basic Attack: Rainbow's End is upgraded to Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.
After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Launches an attack across a large area in front, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
If the skill hits, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of (210 + 10.5 × Chain Attack level)%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Featherglow Rebirth
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Unleashes a slash at the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Fleeting Light
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Awakening Glimmer
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a series of slashes against the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist: Flower & Feather Dance
skills.gameText:
Enters the battlefield and unleashes an attack in a large area, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Consumes 40 Floating Radiance upon activation. With 90 or fewer Floating Radiance remaining upon activation, this Assist: Flower & Feather Dance does not consume Floating Radiance. Remielle also enters the Luminous Reflection state, and the next Basic Attack: Rainbow's End is upgraded to Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.
When this skill hits a Stunned enemy, their Stun duration is extended by 3s. Each enemy can be affected by this effect only once per Stun window. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with other effects of the same type.
If this skill lands a hit, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of (200 + 10 × Assist level)%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Remielle's Refringe Coefficient is equal to 0.02% of her Anomaly Proficiency. If there are 3 Anomaly characters in the squad, her Refringe Coefficient increases by an additional 10%.
When Remielle triggers a Refringe reaction through a teammate, she generates Voidflare based on the enhanced Anomaly Effect Strength of the current Attribute Anomaly after it has been Refringed. Up to the 3 most recently generated Voidflares can be stored.
If Assist: Flower & Feather Dance, Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call, Basic Attack: Rainbow's End, or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace hits a target, Luminize is triggered after the skill ends：
Based on the Anomaly Effect Strength of all stored Voidflares, deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to the enemy using the corresponding skill's DMG multiplier. This multiplier is further increased by 0.2% of Remielle's Anomaly Proficiency.
All stored Voidflares are cleared when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state or after using Basic Attack: Rainbow's End or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Invitation to Bloom
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same faction:
When there are 1/2/3 Anomaly characters in the squad, upon entering the battlefield, all squad members gain an ATK increase equal to 6%/12%/40% of Remielle's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of 1,600 ATK. Remielle's Daze dealt while in the Phase Flow state increases by 6%/12%/35%.
When applying Lumiflux Buildup to an enemy, Remielle also applies the Prismatic effect: All squad members' attacks against enemies with the Prismatic effect have 15% increased Anomaly Buildup Rate. Prismatic is removed when the enemy no longer has Lumiflux Buildup. After Prismatic is removed, the Anomaly Buildup Rate increase persists for an additional 8s.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Naive Oath
skills.gameText: Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflares. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Remielle triggers Luminize to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When using Assist: Flower & Feather Dance, she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s. While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Fall Into the Noise
skills.gameText: Remielle's Refringe Coefficient increases by 20%. When an Anomaly character in the squad deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by Prismatic, the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after Prismatic ends. While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, the frequency at which she automatically attacks to apply Lumiflux Buildup to enemies increases.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: The Garden of Diverging Time
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: The Long Goodbye
skills.gameText: When Remielle triggers Luminize, the DMG multiplier is increased by an additional 12%. After entering the battlefield and gaining 3 special Voidflares, if all Voidflares are consumed, she immediately gains the maximum number of special Voidflares again. This effect to regain special Voidflares is removed after being triggered once or when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: To Drink Forgetfulness
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Lone Feather's Endless Flight
skills.gameText: When Remielle uses Basic Attack: Rainbow's End or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace, Luminize is triggered 2 times. If the 4th hit of her Basic Attack lands against a target, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflares after the skill ends. Special Voidflares gained this way deal DMG equal to 25% of the special Voidflares gained upon entering the battlefield.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Converging Spear
skills.gameText:
While in the Aerial Patrol Spear state and Basic Attack: Converging Spear can be used, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches the corresponding Basic Attack: Converging Spear based on the current stage, dealing Ice DMG.
Basic Attack: Converging Spear has three stages. Each use advances it to the next stage. After performing the third stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, it resets to the first stage.
If Sigrid is attacked while charging the 1st or 2nd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, she blocks with her shield. On a successful block, the attack's DMG is negated, the next Basic Attack: Converging Spear deals 100% more Daze, the Aerial Patrol Spear state is refreshed, and she gains one use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. Press [Basic Attack button] after a successful block to perform the corresponding stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear.
Basic Attack: Converging Spear performed after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear retains the current stage of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear.
DMG taken is reduced by 60% during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable during the third stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Counterthrust
skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

Performs a series of powerful stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
When EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade is chained after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear's hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy and while in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs a series of powerful lunging stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
When EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade is chained after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear's hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a powerful piercing attack against enemies ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gains the Tempered effect, increasing the DMG dealt by subsequent Basic Attack: Converging Spear attacks by 20% for 50s.
When the current skill hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, the current stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear is recorded and then reset before entering the Formation Breaker state. While in Formation Breaker, Aerial Patrol Spear's duration will not be reduced. Hold [Basic Attack button] to continuously activate the 1st through 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. After activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, Formation Breaker ends and Basic Attack: Converging Spear's stage is restored to the recorded stage.
Formation Breaker can trigger at most once against the same target before the target recovers from Stun.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
While in the Formation Breaker state, Basic Attack: Converging Spear does not trigger the Chain Attack window when hitting Stunned enemies.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

skills.label: Core Passive: Sky Knight (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
The 4th hit of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade, EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade, Assist Follow-Up: Devouring Frost, Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice, Ultimate: Frozen Heavens, and Dodge Counter: Counterthrust are considered Unbridled Spear attacks.
Whenever Sigrid hits an enemy with any Unbridled Spear in combat while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, she enters the Aerial Patrol Spear state and gains 1 use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear that cannot be stacked.
While in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, when Sigrid hits an enemy with an Unbridled Spear skill, the Aerial Patrol Spear state is refreshed and she gains 1 use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear that cannot be stacked.
When triggering or refreshing Aerial Patrol Spear, its duration decreases as the stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear increases. At stage 1/2/3, its duration is 8/7/6s.
When Aerial Patrol Spear ends, the stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear is reduced by one, to a minimum of stage 1.
Activating or refreshing Aerial Patrol Spear increases Sigrid's CRIT Rate by 66% for 8s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by 8s, up to a maximum of 40s.
When Sigrid hits a Stunned enemy while in Aerial Patrol Spear, the Stun DMG Multiplier of her DMG dealt to the target is increased by 20%.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Legion of the Skies
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
Sigrid's ATK increases by 120. This effect scales with character level, with each level providing an additional increase of 12, up to a maximum increase of 840.
DMG increases by 15% when hitting enemies in the Contamination state.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Long, Long Ago
skills.gameText: Upon activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, enters the Aerial Patrol Spear and gains 1 additional activation of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. When activations exceed the stored Basic Attack: Converging Spear's activation limit, the next Basic Attack: Converging Spear's final hit deals an additional 100% of ATK as Ice DMG. Sigrid's ATK increases by 25%.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Legend's First Act
skills.gameText: PEN Ratio of Unbridled Spear attacks and Basic Attack: Converging Spear increases by 24%. The duration of Aerial Patrol Spear is extended by 2s. Sigrid's Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%.

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Hero in Training

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Skybound Oath
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Knight of the Skies
skills.gameText: When Basic Attack: Converging Spear's 1st/2nd/3rd stage's final hit lands, it deals an additional 80%/90%/100% ATK as Ice DMG. There is no more limit on the number of times Sigrid can enter the Formation Breaker state upon hitting a Stunned enemy with Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice. Formation Breaker state's Basic Attack: Converging Spear will activate faster.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Bloodforging Four Forms
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Performs up to four strikes forward, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] while in the Crimson Inscription state to activate:
Performs up to three slashes forward with the Blood Axe, dealing Electric DMG.
When the second attack is launched, Claret leaps backward and throws the Blood Axe. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered during the retreat.
When the third attack is launched, Claret performs a series of slashes before leaping up and performing a downward smash. During the repeated slashes, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. Repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack button] to extend the duration of the repeated slashes. Stop pressing or release [Basic Attack button] to make Claret immediately leap up and perform a downward smash. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered while leaping. After successfully triggering a Perfect Dodge, press or hold [Basic Attack button] to follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe
skills.gameText:
While in the Crimson Inscription state, after launching Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron or Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault to trigger Maim, press or hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Spins and leaps into the air with the Blood Axe, then slams down and slashes the target enemy, dealing Electric DMG. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered while leaping.
After using the skill, press or hold [Basic Attack button] to chain into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.

skills.gameText:

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Returning Edge
skills.gameText:

Uses the hammer handle to deliver a powerful forward counterattack, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Bloodbloom Oath - Returning Edge
skills.gameText:

Delivers a powerful forward counterattack with the Blood Axe, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

Transforms the forging hammer into the Blood Axe to slash the target enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
After using this skill, Claret enters the Crimson Inscription state for 16s. While off-field, its duration no longer decreases. When Claret's attacks hit an enemy, if the enemy is defeated within 0.5s and Crimson Inscription's remaining duration is not 0, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 3s. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
During this skill, keep holding [EX Special Attack button] to skip the slash and quickly chain into the alternate Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron and Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault.
After using this skill, press or hold [Basic Attack button] to chain into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron
skills.gameText:
While in the Crimson Inscription state, press [Special Attack button] or [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs a powerful upward slash forward, then follows up with a horizontal slash, dealing Electric DMG.
If the horizontal slash hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, triggers Maim on the target, dealing additional AoE Electric DMG.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill. After successfully inflicting Maim, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault
skills.gameText:
While in the Crimson Inscription state and during the upward slash of Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron, keep holding [Special Attack button] or [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs three consecutive horizontal slashes forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Each horizontal slash that hits an enemy inflicted with Gash triggers Maim on the target, dealing additional AoE Electric DMG. Up to 3 consecutive instances of Maim can be triggered during this skill, with the third having a higher Interrupt Level.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while using this skill. After successfully inflicting Maim, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.gameText:

skills.gameText:

Engages the enemy in a power struggle. Win the struggle to neutralize the enemy's Control Skill and deal Electric DMG.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Bloodbloom Oath - Hammer Into Shape
skills.gameText:

Deals massive Electric DMG. When the heavy attack hits an enemy, it adds one stack of Gash to the target.
Crimson Inscription's duration does not decrease during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Banquet of Pale Blood (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
All DMG dealt by Claret's skills is considered Sharp DMG, and skill DMG Multipliers are based on DEF. Certain Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy is inflicted with Gash, which can stack up to 3 times. When Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron or Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, 1 stack of Gash is consumed to trigger Maim and deal AoE DMG.
When a critical hit is triggered, Sharp DMG doesn't receive the CRIT DMG Bonus and instead uses the Laceration DMG Bonus. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check is performed based on the excess CRIT Rate. If Laceration is triggered, the Laceration DMG Bonus is applied an additional time. For every 1% of Claret's initial CRIT DMG, her initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%.
When Claret enters the battlefield, she gains 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, her Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. When Claret uses a Chain Attack, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s.
While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, CRIT Rate increases by 30% and Gash Buildup Rate increases by 50%. Triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging or Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe increases DMG dealt for the remainder of the skill by 15%.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Bloodline Legacy
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Armorer character, or shares the same attribute:
When any Agent in the squad triggers Contamination, Claret gains 300 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
When Claret or another squad member triggers Maim, all Armorer Agents in the squad enter Remnant Edge. While in the Remnant Edge state, Laceration DMG is increased by 25%, lasting 40s. Triggering Remnant Edge again refreshes its duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Bloodstained Chronicle
skills.gameText: When Claret's attacks hit enemies and trigger Laceration, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%. The DMG Multiplier of Maim triggered by Claret increases to 130% of its original value.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Crown of Inherited Flame
skills.gameText: The maximum duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s. While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, attacks ignore 18% of the target's Electric RES.

DMG dealt by Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging's 3rd hit, Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact, and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial increases by 20%.

skills.label: Special Attack: Much Obliged
skills.gameText:

skills.label: Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off
skills.gameText:
After activating EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace, this attack is automatically activated when the total number of Eyes of the Storm on the field and Roxy's Wind Energy reaches at least 3:
Throws her hammer at enemies on the field, dealing Wind DMG.
Eyes of the Storm hit by this attack are detonated, up to 3 Eyes of the Storm at a time. Based on the number detonated, a corresponding number of Miniature Windstorms are generated, dealing Wind DMG.
If 3 Eyes of the Storm are detonated at once, a Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill
skills.gameText:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Slides forward, dealing Wind DMG.
While sliding, press and hold [EX Special Attack button] to have Roxy enter the Whirlwind state:
While in the Whirlwind state, Roxy generates a tornado. Drag the joystick to control its direction. During this, Energy is continuously consumed, dealing Wind DMG to enemies along its path. When Energy is depleted, or when [EX Special Attack button] is released while the joystick is not being moved, Roxy exits the Whirlwind state.
When the slide ends or when exiting the Whirlwind state, automatically follows up with EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace
skills.gameText:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill ends:
Consumes all Wind Energy to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing Wind DMG.
After the attack, for each point of Wind Energy consumed, deals an additional instance of Wind DMG and generates 1 Eye of the Storm at the current position.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Eye of the Storm
skills.gameText:
Generated after EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace consumes Wind Energy, and automatically detonates after 30s.
Up to 9 Eyes of the Storm can exist at the same time. If this limit is exceeded, the earliest generated Eye of the Storm will automatically detonate.
Detonates when hit by Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off. If fewer than 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Miniature Windstorm is generated at the location of each Eye of the Storm, tracking enemies and dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
If 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
When detonated by any means, an Eye of the Storm releases a blast, dealing 1 instance of Wind DMG to nearby enemies.

Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front, dealing massive Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.gameText:

After the skill ends, gains 1 Wind Energy.

skills.label: Core Passive: Warm Night's Embrace (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Gain 1 point of Wind Energy for every 25 Energy consumed, up to a maximum of 3 Wind Energy.
When Roxy's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, for every 0.01 above this value, ATK increases by 5, up to a maximum increase of 960, and Impact increases by 0.4, up to a maximum increase of 76.8.
After Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off hits an enemy affected by Windswept, it triggers Cleanse, reverting Contamination back to its original state.
When any squad member triggers Contamination or Cleanse, Roxy provides all squad members with a buff based on the attribute of the Contamination or Cleanse effect: for every 1% CRIT Rate Roxy has, when non-Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their CRIT DMG increases by 0.4%, up to 40%. When Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their Laceration DMG increases by 0.2%, up to 20%. Each attribute's buff lasts 50s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Windswept is applied again to an enemy already in the Windswept state, all squad members can also gain this buff based on the Contamination attribute of the overwritten Windswept state and Wind attribute.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Porcelloy Heart
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Rupture, or Armorer character:
Roxy's DMG increases by 8%. This effect increases with character level, increasing by 1.2% per level, up to 80%.
When any squad member's attack hits an enemy, it increases their Stun DMG Multiplier by 30%. When an enemy becomes Stunned, its Stun duration is extended by 2s. This Stun duration increase does not stack with similar effects. The effect is removed once the Stun ends.
While an enemy is in the Windswept state applied by a squad member, the direct Wind DMG they take and the direct DMG they take of the attribute that triggered Contamination are increased by 8%.
Upon entering the battlefield, restores 40 Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Windswept applied by all squad members lasts 20s longer.
When using an EX Special Attack, Roxy's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 30% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Versatile Attendant
skills.gameText: When EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace hits, it reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Clocking Out Myth
skills.gameText:
EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill deals 5% more Daze.
For each Eye of the Storm detonated, gain 1 stack of Windflow, up to 3 stacks.
During EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill, if Roxy switches out after entering the Whirlwind state, she consumes all Windflow. Each stack consumed sustains the Whirlwind state for 0.2s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of 0.6s.
When EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% until the target recovers from Stun.

skills.label: Mindscape 4: R.I.P.
skills.gameText: When a Defensive Assist successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains 1 Energy, up to once per skill. When Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy hits an enemy, it grants 2 Energy, up to once per skill. Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial deals 20% more DMG and 10% more Daze.

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Eternity and the Clockwork Doll
skills.gameText:
The DMG dealt by attacks ignores 15% of the target's Wind RES.
When Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off detonates Eyes of the Storm to generate a Giant Windstorm, the primary target is inflicted with Afterecho. A Giant Windstorm is generated at the target's location every 3s, for a total of 2 additional Giant Windstorms. Repeated triggers stack the number of additional Giant Windstorm instances generated and refresh the duration of Afterecho. The DMG dealt by the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Daze it inflicts increases by 20%.

skills.gameText:

Unleash up to 4 consecutive attacks forward, dealing Wind DMG.
After the 4th attack hits an enemy, accumulate 20 Flowing Breath.
The 4th attack has Dodge properties the moment it is unleashed. If an enemy attack is successfully dodged, the DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier of this Basic Attack become equal to those of [Basic Attack: Fierce Whirl], and an additional 15 [Flowing Breath] is accumulated.
Severian is invulnerable while unleashing the 4th attack.

skills.label: Core Passive: Nirvana (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Phoenix's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 85 points.
When any squad member deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to an enemy, that enemy enters the [Searing Corrosion] state for 20s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When an enemy in the [Searing Corrosion] state takes Attribute Anomaly DMG, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit, with a Base CRIT Rate of 30% and CRIT DMG of 25%. If Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery is greater than 155 points, each point of Anomaly Mastery beyond that increases this effect's CRIT Rate by an additional 0.7%.
When Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery reaches 255 points, the CRIT Rate of Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt to enemies in the [Searing Corrosion] state reaches its maximum value.
Every 8s, enemies in the [Searing Corrosion] state take Fire DMG equal to 50% of Phoenix's ATK. This DMG is considered [EX Special Attack] DMG.
While [Blazing Assault] is active, Phoenix's Anti-Interrupt Level increases, and dealing DMG restores [Pyreflame]. Phoenix can hold up to 120 points of [Pyreflame].
After [Blazing Assault] is activated, press [Special Attack button] to skip the backstep action of [Special Attack: Flame Snatch] and [EX Special Attack: Blaze Cleave] and immediately follow up with an upward strike.
When Phoenix takes fatal damage, she will not be defeated and withdraw from battle, and can trigger the [Rekindled Radiance] effect: the next time she enters the field via a normal swap, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist, she restores 50% of her Max HP. In Withering Domain mode, this effect can trigger once every 1,200.
When Phoenix triggers a Perfect Block effect, she gains 5 points of [Pyreflame]. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
When Phoenix uses an [EX Special Attack], she enters the [Wax and Wane] state for 20s. When [Blazing Assault] hits an enemy or is applied again, the duration refreshes.
While in the [Wax and Wane] state, after using [EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare], the next [EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare] will be replaced by [EX Special Attack: Falling Sun].
